column1: # Class -> higher group, for leave-one-clade-out folds. A class with too few positive clusters or
# too few hard negatives to stand alone is scored inside its group instead, so a thin clade is
# merged on purpose rather than silently dropped or left as a fold of two proteins.
# Thresholds and the per-fold decision are in build_benchmark.py (MIN_FOLD_POSITIVES / MIN_FOLD_NEGATIVES).
